scoring_note: Projections: recency-weighted mean of each player's last <=4 games, scored under DK's exact NFL rules (nfl.dfs.scoring, verified 2026-09-11). DST has no per-team feed yet, so it falls back to DK's own season avg (marked). Lineups: a heuristic greedy+local-search optimizer (build-doc S5), not a solved optimum -- a reasonable starting point, especially worth a sanity glance on any cheap/low-sample player before entering for real. Each lineup is hard-forced (build-doc addendum, 2026-09-13) to carry a QB+WR from the favorite and a bring-back pass-catcher from the underdog of one of the week's 3 highest-projected-total games -- a different game per lineup where the data allows it; a lineup shown without a 'game stack' tag means no game could be seated this week (missing game line, or no projectable player on one side) and it fell back to the plain optimizer instead.
